subtitle: Out Cebu · Vietnam Airlines
overview: Fly Vietnam Airlines from Cebu to Shanghai via Hanoi and stay four nights in a 4★ hotel. Explore Suzhou’s Tongli Ancient Town, Three Bridges, Chongben Hall and Tuisi Garden, see the Bund, Nanjing Road, Xintiandi and Chenghuang Temple, and spend a day at Shanghai Disneyland with the entrance ticket included. No shopping stops appear in the itinerary.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Jan 15–19 2027 to Jun 11–15 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Tongli Ancient Town: A canal town near Suzhou with old stone bridges, waterways and traditional houses.
placeDesc.Three Bridges: A group of three historic stone bridges in Tongli's canal area, visited on the walking tour.
placeDesc.Chongben Hall: A traditional Qing-era residence in Tongli's old town with a classic Chinese courtyard layout.
placeDesc.Tuisi Garden: A classical Suzhou garden in Tongli, designed around a central pond.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's main pedestrian shopping street, lined with stores and neon lights.
placeDesc.World’s largest Starbucks Flagship Store: A large Starbucks Reserve store in Shanghai, visited during the city tour.
placeDesc.Xintiandi: A Shanghai lifestyle district of restored traditional stone-gate houses with cafes and shops.
placeDesc.Shikumen: Shanghai's traditional stone-gate (shikumen) lane houses, preserved in the Xintiandi area.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: The City God Temple area in old Shanghai, with traditional buildings and shops.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: A full day at the Disney theme park, with entrance ticket included, ending after the fireworks.
